about_the_game:
Crosshair Pro – Modern Game Crosshair Overlay Application

Crosshair Pro is a modern overlay application that gives you full control over your in-game crosshair customization on PC. Designed for FPS, TPS, and competitive games, it allows you to create the perfect crosshair. Adjust live sizing, gradient and glow effects, ring segments, dot and line styles, and apply them instantly with global shortcuts or OBS capture mode. Save crosshairs as presets, export them as PNG or SVG, or let the app automatically switch crosshairs based on the active game EXE.

Key Features:

  • Easy Designer: Quickly adjust crosshair size, color, line, and effects using intuitive sliders.

  • Share & Collaborate: Share your crosshair designs with friends and use community presets.

  • Show/Hide Shortcuts: Instantly toggle crosshair visibility with customizable hotkeys.

  • Monitor & Game Profiles: Manage crosshair positions across multiple monitors and create game-specific profiles.

  • Export Options: Save your custom crosshairs as high-quality PNG or SVG files.

  • Game-Focused: Optimized for FPS, TPS, and competitive games.

  • OBS Compatibility: Seamlessly use your crosshair while streaming.

Enhance your gaming experience with Crosshair Pro—customize, export, and gain professional-level control over your crosshair!
